# Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026)

> Online 40-hour HAZWOPER training for California workers new to uncontrolled hazardous waste or emergency response operations, covering Cal/OSHA Title 8, Section 5192, paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulations: Title 8 CCR §5192 (a)–(q); 29 CFR 1910.120(e); 29 CFR 1926.65(e)
- Scope: the education portion of 40-hour HAZWOPER. Three days of in-person field training led by a trained, experienced supervisor are also required and provided by the employer (hands-on PPE, site-specific risks).
- Duration: 40 hours; 18 modules, 80 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 4.0 CEU
- Price: $229.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device, audio playback; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months; renew with the annual Cal/OSHA 8-hour refresher
- Prerequisites: none

## Work covered by HAZWOPER
Cleanup at hazardous waste sites; hazardous waste operations at TSD facilities; emergency response to hazardous substance releases.

## Who needs 40 hours
Most workers new to uncontrolled hazardous waste or emergency response operations: equipment operators, general laborers, other site workers, on-site managers and supervisors.

## Modules (lesson count)
1. Regulatory Overview (3)
2. Planning and Organization (2)
3. Site Characterization (5)
4. Medical Surveillance (2)
5. Toxicology (3)
6. Hazard Classification (6)
7. Chemical Hazards (6)
8. Radiological Hazards (2)
9. Respiratory Protection (5)
10. Personal Protective Equipment (8)
11. Decontamination (6)
12. Air Monitoring (6)
13. Compressed Gases (4)
14. Material Sampling and Analysis (3)
15. Handling Drums (4)
16. Confined Spaces (8)
17. Excavations (3)
18. Emergency Response Procedures (4)
